G5613.kjv: about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed
senses: As relat. adv. of manner, as, like as, just as, even as;

with a demonstrative, like οὕτως, expressed or understood: οὕτως... ὡς, [[r:MRK.4.26|Mrk 4:26]], [[r:1CO.3.15|1Co 3:15]], [[r:EPH.5.28|Eph 5:28]], [[r:JAS.2.12|Jas 2:12]], al.; ὡς... οὕτως, [[r:ACT.8.32|Act 8:32]], [[r:1CO.7.17|1Co 7:17]], al.; elliptically (sc. οὕτως, οὕτω), with nom., [[r:MAT.6.29|Mat 6:29]], al.; with accusative, [[r:MAT.19.19|Mat 19:19]], [[r:MRK.12.31|Mrk 12:31]], al.; with prep., [[r:MAT.26.55|Mat 26:55]], [[r:MRK.14.48|Mrk 14:48]], [[r:LUK.22.52|Luk 22:52]], [[r:JHN.7.10|Jhn 7:10]], al.; with verb., [[r:JHN.15.6|Jhn 15:6]], [[r:2CO.3.1|2Co 3:1]], [[r:EPH.2.3|Eph 2:3]], [[r:1TH.5.6|1Th 5:6]], al.; with ptcp. Before adjectives and adverbs, how: [[r:ROM.10.15|Rom 10:15 11:33]], [[r:1TH.2.10|1Th 2:10]]; with superl., ὡς τάχιστα, as quickly as possible, [[r:ACT.17.15|Act 17:15.]]
Final, in order that; with inf., in order to (M, Pr., 204n), [[r:LUK.9.52|Luk 9:52]], [[r:ACT.20.24|Act 20:24]], [[r:HEB.7.9|Heb 7:9]]. (AS)

DB, ext., 475b 476b). (AS)
